title: 第六章 天凤心法
content_zh:
白婧秀眉微皱，显然是不相信任天一的说辞，但她并没有说破，只是默默的看着他，心中再次疑惑道：“他到底傻还是不傻？”

    任天一双手一摊，耸耸肩道：“就知道娘子不信。”

    当即唤石头，让他找来了笔墨纸砚，写出了一部针对白婧玄阴凤体修炼的心法——《天凤心法》，当然这是他前世偶然得到的心法，是针对玄阴凤体体质的专用心法，没想到竟在这里排上了用场。

    他只写出了功法的具体内容，并没有注明功法的名字。

    任天一将心法放到白婧面前道：“这也是那大能给我的，说是一部治你病的心法，这是其中一部分，婧儿你且试试看。”

    “治我病？心法？”

    心法能治病？闻所未闻，白婧不禁觉得有些好笑。

    虽然觉得好笑，她还是接过了心法，不论真假，她只当是解闷了。

    随即白婧脸上的笑容消失不见，取而代之的是严肃和凝重，更有一些难以置信，不但有心法口诀，更有一些注意事项的批注，可谓是非常详细。

    她按照心法的方法试了一下，立马感觉到丹田内那股从来不受控的劲流，竟然破天荒的减弱了几分。

    “这心法真的能给我的身心带来益处！”白婧激动不已，兴奋地喊道：“六郎，你说的竟然是真的！”

    任天一笑而不语，这一刻，他太累了，应对任天行的白猿拳几乎耗尽了他所有的气力，此时他需要的是休息。

    明月明兰将屋子也拾掇好了，将白婧的箱子也搬了进来，她们关好门就退了出去。

    白婧恋恋不舍的放下手中的心法，起身将任天一扶到床上，并帮他脱去了衣袍，任天一贴身的衣物尽被汗水浸透，方才那一战对任天一的消耗可见一斑。

    将任天一安顿好，白婧迫不及待的拿起心法，细细的领悟起来。

    白婧明显感觉到这心法像是为她量身打造一般，她只觉得自己如沐春风，体内舒爽无比，白婧不自觉的沉浸其中。

    ……

    时间悄然流逝，此时天色依然大亮。
content_en:
Bai Jing frowned slightly, obviously not believing what Ren Tianyi said, but she didn't say anything. She just looked at him silently, wondering again: "Is he stupid or not?"

    Ren Tian spread his hands, shrugged and said, "I know the lady doesn't believe it."

    Immediately called Shitou, asked him to find pen, ink, paper and inkstone, and wrote a mental method for Bai Jing's Xuanyin Phoenix Body cultivation - "Tianfeng Heart Method". Of course, this was a mental method he had accidentally obtained in his previous life, and it was a special mental method for Xuanyin Phoenix Body. Unexpectedly, it would be put to use here.

    He only wrote down the specific content of the exercise, but did not indicate the name of the exercise.

    Ren Tianyi put the mental method in front of Bai Jing and said: "This is what the great power gave me. It is said to be a mental method to cure your disease. This is part of it. Jing'er, please give it a try."

    "Cure me? Mental method?"

    Can mental methods cure diseases? It was unheard of, and Bai Jing couldn't help but find it a little funny.

    Although she found it funny, she still accepted the idea. Regardless of whether it was true or false, she just regarded it as a way to relieve her boredom.

    Immediately, the smile on Bai Jing's face disappeared, replaced by a serious and solemn look, which was even more unbelievable. Not only did she have mental formulas, but also some notes on precautions, which were very detailed.

    She tried it according to the mental method, and immediately felt that the uncontrollable power in her dantian weakened for the first time.

    "This mental method can really benefit my body and mind!" Bai Jing was so excited that she shouted excitedly: "Liu Lang, what you said is actually true!"

    Ren Tian smiled and said nothing. At this moment, he was too tired. The White Ape Fist against Ren Tianxing almost exhausted all his energy. What he needed at this time was to rest.

    Mingyue Minglan also tidied up the house and moved Bai Jing's boxes in. They closed the door and left.

    Bai Jing reluctantly put down what she was doing, stood up and helped Ren Tianyi to the bed, and helped him take off his robe. Ren Tianyi's clothes were soaked with sweat, and the wear and tear on Ren Tianyi from the previous battle was evident.

    After Ren Tianyi settled down, Bai Jing couldn't wait to pick up the method and comprehend it carefully.

    Bai Jing clearly felt that this mental method was tailor-made for her. She just felt like a spring breeze, and her body was extremely comfortable. Bai Jing was unconsciously immersed in it.

    …

    Time passed quietly, and the sky was still bright at this time.
